title: Enquiry From Netherlands Consulate-General Regarding

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. SECRETARY.
No. D 5866
Date 10 / 5 / 34

May 10 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information
copy of correspondence which is self explanatory
and shall be obliged if you will return to Mr.
Van den Berg in due course the appendix containing
particulars of the man Wong Tjin Djim.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Political Section,
French Police Headquarters.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. S. 秘书。
编号 D 5866
日期 34年5月10日

1934年5月10日。

亲爱的萨利先生：

现随函附上往来信函副本，其内容自明，供你方参考。如蒙将包含黄振金（Wong Tjin Djim）详细情况的附件及时退还给范登伯格先生，我将不胜感激。

此致，

〔此处为手写签名〕

R. 萨利先生，
政治科，
法国警察总局。

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S. B. REGISTRY. / 574）
S. No. D. Stations
Date ____ 16 / 5 / 34

Subject (in full) Enquiry from Netherlands Consulate-General regarding the
arrival of a deportee on board the s.s. 'Tjinegara'

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J.B. Ku. O.I.

（左侧批注：Berthed at Holi- / wharf, Norture- / D.R.）

With reference to the attached letter dated April 28
from the Netherlands Consulate-General concerning the arrival
here on the s.s. 'Tjinegara' of a deportee from Semarang, I have
to report that a Chinese who was deported on the grounds that
he had no means of subsistence arrived at Shanghai by this
vessel on May 6. His name is Wong Chin Kyung. The Chinese
characters are not obtainable, only the romanisation being
entered on the ship's manifest. On the arrival of the vessel
he he left for an unknown destination.

It is understood that there is nothing against this
individual apart from his being found destitute.

（签名：D.S. Jones）
D.S.
Officer i/c Special Branch

表格第3号
G. 25,000-1-34

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 S. B. 登记处。/ 574）
S. 编号 D. 警站
日期 ____ 34年5月16日

主题（全称） 荷兰总领事馆关于被驱逐者乘坐“Tjinegara”号轮船抵达一事的查询

由 D.S. 琼斯制作 经由 J.B. Ku. O.I. 转呈

（左侧批注：停泊于霍利- / 码头，北苏- / D.R.）

关于所附荷兰总领事馆4月28日来信，提及一名来自三宝垄的被驱逐者乘坐“Tjinegara”号轮船抵达此地一事，兹报告如下：一名因无生计来源而被驱逐的华人于5月6日乘该轮抵达上海。其名为 Wong Chin Kyung。无法获取其中文汉字，船运舱单上仅录入罗马拼音。该轮抵达后，此人前往未知目的地。

据悉，除被发现贫困潦倒外，此人并无其他不良记录。

（签名：D.S. 琼斯）
D.S.
特务科主管警官

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1419.

SHANGHAI, 8 May 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date ____ / ____）

Sir,

Further to my letter of 28 April 1934, No.1311,
I have the honour to send you herewith full particulars
concerning Wong Tjin Djin ( 王 成 珍 ) who was ordered
to leave Netherlands India on account of the fact that
he had no valid admission papers and was found to have
no means of subsistence.

I should be greatly obliged to you, if you would
send the annex to the French Police with the request to
have same returned to me again.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Special Branch,
SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址 HOLLANDIA。

编号 1419。

上海，1934年5月8日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处。
编号 D
日期 ____ / ____）

先生：

继我1934年4月28日第1311号信函之后，谨此奉送有关王成珍（Wong Tjin Djin ( 王 成 珍 )）之详细情况。该人因无有效入境证件且被发现无生计来源，被勒令离开荷属东印度。

如蒙将附件转送法国警方，并嘱其阅后退回予我，我将不胜感激。

谨此致意，

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处为手写签名〕

华务秘书。

T. 罗伯逊先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
特务科，
上海。

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1311.

SHANGHAI,

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D ____
Date 28th April, 1934.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I am in receipt
of a telegram from Semarang to the effect that one person,
most probably a Chinese, is being expelled and sent to
Shanghai by the "Tjinegara" which is expected to arrive
here on May the 6th.

So far I have received no particulars as to the person
expelled or the reasons for his deportation, which may be
political or purely administrative, but as soon as parti-
culars are received I will not fail to notify you at once.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Special Branch,
SHANGHAI.

（批：D. S. Jones.
DSR 7/5.）
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址 HOLLANDIA。

编号 1311。

上海，

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处。
编号 D ____
日期 1934年4月28日。）

先生：

谨此告知，我已收到来自三宝垄的电报，称有一人（极可能为华人）正被驱逐并由预计于5月6日抵达此地的“Tjinegara”号轮船送往上海。

截至目前，我尚未收到关于该被驱逐者或其被驱逐原因（可能是政治性的或纯行政性的）的详细情况，但一旦收到详情，我定当立即通知贵方。

谨此致意，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

〔此处为手写签名〕
华务秘书。

T. 罗伯逊先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
特务科，
上海。

（批注：D. S. 琼斯。
DSR 5月7日。）
